gloss: to offer (flowers, incense) to the dead

definitions.gloss: to offer (flowers, incense, prayers) to the dead
definitions.explanation: To place flowers, incense or words before the dead, at a grave, an altar or the site of a death. Also, figuratively, to give parting words to someone leaving.

examples.english: I offered flowers at the grave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}ける⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧。
examples.english: People keep coming to lay flowers at the accident site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旅立|たびだ}つ→旅立つ：12951_tabidatsu⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{励|はげ}まし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}けた。
examples.english: At the graduation, the principal gave words of encouragement to the departing students.
